name: inline-edit
title: Inline Edit
description: A compact dark card listing event details as labelled rows. Hovering a row shows a pencil, and clicking it swaps the value for a text field with springy save and cancel buttons that write the change back.
use: A compact details panel needs quick field edits without opening a separate form or modal.
avoid: The edit trigger only shows on hover and is not focusable, so touch and keyboard users may not find it.
a11y: The pencil trigger is a non-focusable div, the icon buttons have no labels, and no reduced-motion check exists. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded card in near-black with a small uppercase header strip and five rows. Each row starts with a thin grey line icon and a grey label, with a lighter value to its right and a faint square pencil button at the row's end.
behaves: Hovering a row fades in its pencil button; clicking it animates a text field into place along with a dark tick button and a cross button. The tick saves the value back to the card, Enter also saves a single-line row, and the cross abandons the edit.
customise: The details object, a change callback and the header title are props; the labels, icons and which fields exist are fixed in the file.
weight: light: A handful of rows with layout springs that only animate when a row is edited.
demo: Event "Design Systems Meetup", Thursday 12 March, 6:30 to 9:00 PM, stashui.dev/meetup, plus a description.
issues: Save and cancel are icon-only buttons with no accessible label.
The edit button is invisible until hover, so touch users see no way to start editing.
polishWhy: Calm, well-spaced rows and satisfying springs; hover-only editing and unlabelled icons are gaps.
